name: q8_fly_reservoir_sensory
purpose: Sparse-port injection: language tokens enter ONLY through the 15,912 annotated sensory neurons (cb/ol/vnc sensory + ascending/descending sensory); the other 149,210 neurons receive no direct drive. The broadcast shortcut that made the wiring inert at level 0 is removed by construction - information must flow through the frozen wiring to be read. Everything else identical to the level-0 arm (frozen signed wiring, LIF, trained input projection 128->15,912 and weighted readout over all neurons, tied decoder, registered OWT protocol).
falsifiable_expectation: With routing mandatory, NLL should start far worse than the broadcast arm (7.619 at 500) and the wiring should become causally alive: eval-time wiring perturbations (relabel/zero/sign-flip) must produce NONZERO deltas, unlike level 0's byte-identical inertness. Firing rate should grow as the input projection learns to drive the wiring.
